text:
leo: Heads-up — customer reported PII appearing in logs. Proposing an "emergency scrub" tenant-level toggle in the console to immediately stop storing unredacted samples.

sara: Two quick q: 1) per-tenant or per-route? 2) what happens to in-flight messages?

leo: Per-tenant hard-stop. Future samples go to ephemeral-only; in-flight items are marked for async purge and excluded from long-term retention. Action requires 2FA + reason.

gina: UX: red button with confirmation modal that requires a reason and 2FA. Show actor/timestamp in audit row and a readonly 90d timeline of past toggles.

ops-bot: Incident template 'emergency-scrub' created and attached.

legal: Purges must be immutably logged. Rehydration requires legal case-id + 2-person approval; escaping purge via backups is a compliance risk.

ops: Implementation: router sets header `x-scrub-mode: emergency`. Ingestion drops storage writes and emits metric `scrub.emergency.{tenant}`. Quota accounting must still decrement so rate limits remain accurate.

sara: Also block derived artifacts during emergency-scrub (no embeddings/reranks) or only store redacted-derived artifacts. Prefer disable-by-default.

leo: Rollout: feature-flag in staging for a week, then ops-only enable for 10% tenants in prod. Keep anonymized metadata (no content) for 1yr for auditability.

gina: Will post UI mock by EOD tomorrow.

ops: I'll add ACL checks and lock weekend usage off by default. Assigning purge job stub to infra.

leo: Thanks — I'll open the PR for router header + metric. Keep this thread for follow-ups and share runbook once drafted.
